# Subject-Logics — The Ø Traversal

## #0 — Presence before its self-description

A thought appears. It can be mistaken, forgotten, contradicted or recognised as a thought about itself. Each change occurs in the presence through which the thought was available at all. The subject's logic begins with this distinction between the fact of appearing and its determinate contents. A false self-description remains a real occurrence; its occurrence does not make the description true.

[Defined indefinability](../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) distinguishes the presence in which something appears from each determinate appearance. `0` names the unobjectifiable subject-pole: that to which an appearance is present, including every image of the one experiencing it. Any denial of this first-person fact is itself performed in that presence. No corresponding immunity belongs to the denial's content, a remembered identity or an explanation of what the subject is.

In Taylor’s [recognition sequence](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), `0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1` returns as `0/1`. This is one developed unit within the eight-determination field: the knowing relation becomes occluded, discovers its mediation and recognises itself through the field it has differentiated. The initial `0` marks the subject's priority in this account. Manifest appearing already involves its relation to what appears.

## #1 — The instrument taken as the I

Attention, memory, judgment and the activity of taking something as mine give experience a determinate organisation. The Sanskrit term *antaḥkaraṇa*, the inner instrument, names this mediating apparatus. It can itself become something known: I notice what I have attended to, question a judgment, or recognise the habit by which I claimed an experience as mine. Occlusion occurs when that describable apparatus is taken as the final knower.

QL writes the occlusion `Ø`. The slash has been fused into the zero, so a composite relation appears to be a single self-thing. In the computational compression, computation is confused for the computer: an operation of the instrument takes the subject's office. The point is the exchange of offices itself. A describable operation of the means is promoted into the place of the knower, and the relation through which both operation and description appear disappears from the account.

Taylor’s [reopening of the cogito](../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) hears the indubitable correctly: thinking, doubting and being deceived are present. The movement into a thinking-thing gathers that presence too quickly under a determinate description. In his [definitional reading](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md), I am aware of thinking. Thinking is available through awareness; awareness is not a further conclusion manufactured by thinking.

Taylor places Hume at the same position by reading the occlusion from its other side: only impressions are found among the contents, and their failure to yield a self is taken against the subject. These are authorial diagnostic placements, not accounts of either philosopher's intentions. The historical [cogito encounter](episteme/sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/descartes/descartes-1641-meditations/descartes-1641-meditations.md) retains its outstanding exact-edition passage debt. The fact/contents discrimination remains the essay's own argument.

## #2 — The field cut into objects

The same instrument which produces an apparent owner also discriminates the owner's world. It selects, names, compares and retains. `X` marks this field of crossings: objects as available through differentiation. `Ø` and `X` are consequently two crystallisations of the slash's activity, its apparent self on one side and its articulated world on the other. Their apparent independence conceals their common mediation.

This does not give the private ego the power to manufacture reality. The ego is already a determination within the field. The idealist order of dependence—Subject/Consciousness, Mind/Objective Internality, Object—keeps the ontological claim at full strength precisely by refusing that substitution. Nor does the order describe three events happening one after another. Any account of their chronology already occurs within appearing.

The [mediating field](../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) is positively real: memory and judgment have organisation and consequences. Their becoming inspectable does not abolish them; it allows the subject's apparent independence and the world's apparent self-givenness to be examined together.

## #3 — The slash becomes visible

`Ø/X` exposes mediation between the apparent subject and its object-field. The stroke which seemed inseparable from the self now appears as a relation: the activity through which something has become this object for this situated knower. Recognition begins to change the instrument's use because its determinations can return to the operations that produced them.

The traditional distinction between *pramātṛ*, knower, *pramāṇa*, means of knowing, and *prameya*, known, distinguishes three offices within one knowing act. In Taylor’s QL reading, numerator, slash and denominator make those offices legible. None can simply replace another. Inspecting the means does not place the first-person condition of that inspection among its inspected contents; affirming the subject does not make the known immune to examination.

Taylor brings Lacan's bar and the *point de capiton*, the quilting point, into this relation. The master signifier `S1` fastens the signifying chain into a local meaning; the linking `1` performs that office in the QL synthesis. Any local fastening already requires the chain to be present. *Anusyūta*, stitched-through-ness, names the pre-quilting continuity in this authorial Śaiva refraction. The thread and the button perform different work: another button cannot supply what buttoning presupposes. Taylor’s comparison joins these distinct operations without attributing the QL subject to Lacan.

## #4 — The relations become available together

The next expression holds both sides under recognition:

$$
(0/Ø)/(1/X).
$$

`0/Ø` distinguishes unobjectifiable presence from the apparent subject. `1/X` gathers the differentiated object-field in relation to its affirmed unity. The outer slash holds these two readings together. The instrument, its self-image, its world and the presence through which they are given become available in one field. Context now includes the manner in which context has been made.

Unity here retains the differentiated field. The set-theoretic neighbour makes the work of a linking `1` inspectable: in von Neumann's construction, `0 = ∅`, `1 = {∅}` and `2 = {∅,{∅}} = {0,1}`. The singleton has the empty set as its member; it is not itself empty. QL reads this exact distinction as a formal neighbour for a mark which links without becoming identical to what it links. The empty set remains a mathematical object; unobjectifiable presence does not become a set.

In [the crossed-zero figure](../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/16-s1-p3-crossed-zero.md), the stroke remains present while fused with the apparent singular self. Recognition retains that graphic composition while distinguishing occlusion, disclosed mediation and the simultaneous availability of the relations on both sides. The stroke can become legible as medium instead of being erased to recover an untouched zero.

## #5→0 — The affirmed one retains its source

At `1`, the subject's relation to its differentiated world is recognised as one being. The apparent self has not won possession of the subject-pole. What was occluded as `Ø` can now be affirmed through the relations which the occlusion hid. The linking mark remains determinate while knowing its dependence; an achieved name can hold meaning without claiming to originate the field of meaning. Its provisionality is exact: the signifier can be revised while the presence through which revision occurs cannot be supplied by a replacement signifier.

Within a [technical and ethical encounter](../section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/AC.md), an internality's representation belongs among the contents available for examination. In a local act, the judging agent is the relative functional knower; its memory, model, rules, tools and context are means; the situation and alternatives it discriminates are its known field. Those offices arise together in the determination. Within the containing person’s inquiry, the complete apparatus itself participates in the means. A further inspection makes that local centre, its rule or self-description known in another act. The first-person condition of the inspecting act remains active through the inspection; adding represented contents cannot convert that condition into another object among them. Recovering the local centre together with its means, known field and containing inquiry makes the instrument more legible and more capable of return. An encountered discrepancy can correct an answer, task or model under a fitting criterion, or expose a source, rule, permission or commission which needs revision. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons. The next act inherits that warranted correction or retention, while another person’s answer remains capable of changing the account through which they were approached.

The [inverse orientation, 1/0](1-0.md), turns the affirmed one toward the condition it cannot acquire. Its manifest return is `0/1`, presence and appearing in their recognised relation. The slash can operate again without disappearing into an owner. The field has become more available through the recognition, and every further determination remains capable of returning.
